purpose: Improve the harness based on observed friction or missing process mechanics.
positive_examples: incorporate context-mode mechanisms without adding a dependency
add context budget discipline to the agent harness
negative_examples: fix a runtime bug in app code
work_loop: identify the harness gap and desired behavior
update the governing spec before implementation when the contract changes
add failing validation for the missing harness behavior
implement the smallest harness change that makes the agent move toward outcomes
update docs and memory when the lesson is reusable
run proof commands and read the output
done_when: harness behavior is executable, not merely descriptive
fallback_policy: When in doubt, choose the change that makes the next agent action explicit and verifiable.
